name: servicenow-mcp-ai

tools.name: servicenow_query_table
tools.description: Read records from any ServiceNow table through the Table API. Supports encoded queries, field selection and pagination.

fields.description: Columns to return. Omit to return all columns.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 10).

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

displayValue.description: Return display values ('true'), raw values ('false', default) or both ('all').

fetchAll.description: When true, page through all matching records (up to the server's SN_MAX_RECORDS cap) instead of a single page.

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default), or 'csv' for a spreadsheet-friendly export.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_get_record
tools.description: Read a single record from a table by its sys_id.

sys_id.description: The sys_id of the record to read.

fields.description: Columns to return. Omit to return all columns.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_create_record
tools.description: Create a new record in a table with the given field values.

fields.description: Field name/value pairs for the new record, e.g. { "short_description": "Printer down", "urgency": "2" }.

apply.description: Execute the change. In the default plan mode, omitting this returns a non-mutating before/after preview; set true to apply. SN_WRITE_MODE=apply makes execution the default.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_update_record
tools.description: Update fields on an existing record identified by its sys_id.

sys_id.description: The sys_id of the record to update.

fields.description: Field name/value pairs to change on the record.

apply.description: Execute the change. In the default plan mode, omitting this returns a non-mutating before/after preview; set true to apply. SN_WRITE_MODE=apply makes execution the default.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_delete_record
tools.description: Delete a record from a table by its sys_id.

sys_id.description: The sys_id of the record to delete.

apply.description: Execute the change. In the default plan mode, omitting this returns a non-mutating before/after preview; set true to apply. SN_WRITE_MODE=apply makes execution the default.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_list_tables
tools.description: List tables from sys_db_object, optionally filtered by a name or label fragment.

filter.description: Case-insensitive fragment to match in name or label.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_describe_table
tools.description: List a table's columns (name, label, type, mandatory, reference) from sys_dictionary.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_aggregate
tools.description: Compute server-side aggregates (count, avg, min, max, sum) over a table via the Stats API, with optional grouping. Avoids pulling individual rows.

query.description: Encoded query to filter rows before aggregating.

min_fields.description: Fields to take the minimum of.

max_fields.description: Fields to take the maximum of.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_list_attachments
tools.description: List attachment metadata, optionally scoped to a specific record (table + sys_id).

table.description: Table the record belongs to, e.g. 'incident'.

sys_id.description: sys_id of the record whose attachments to list.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_get_attachment
tools.description: Read a single attachment's metadata by its sys_id.

attachment_sys_id.description: The sys_id of the attachment record.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_download_attachment
tools.description: Download an attachment's bytes, returned as base64. Large files are refused (see SN_MAX_RESULT_CHARS).

attachment_sys_id.description: The sys_id of the attachment to download.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_upload_attachment
tools.description: Attach a file (provided as base64) to a record identified by table + sys_id.

sys_id.description: sys_id of the record to attach to.

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. 'text/plain'. Defaults to octet-stream.

apply.description: Execute the change. In the default plan mode, omitting this returns a non-mutating before/after preview; set true to apply. SN_WRITE_MODE=apply makes execution the default.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment by its sys_id.

attachment_sys_id.description: The sys_id of the attachment to delete.

apply.description: Execute the change. In the default plan mode, omitting this returns a non-mutating before/after preview; set true to apply. SN_WRITE_MODE=apply makes execution the default.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_set_credentials
tools.description: Save or update the ServiceNow connection credentials. Values are persisted to the env file and used for all subsequent requests. Provide any subset of fields.

profile.description: Connection profile to write (default: the active one). Use a new name to create a profile.

tools.name: servicenow_list_instances
tools.description: List the configured ServiceNow connection profiles (instances): name, host, user, read-only flag and whether credentials are complete. Passwords are never included.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_use_instance
tools.description: Switch the active ServiceNow connection profile (persisted to the env file). All identity-scoped caches (OAuth tokens, schema, plugin availability) are cleared.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_get_status
tools.description: Show the configured instance, user, auth mode and access policy, and whether credentials are complete. The password is never revealed.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_test_connection
tools.description: Verify that the configured credentials actually work: reads one sys_user record and reports ok/status/latency. Auth and connectivity problems are returned structurally (ok:false), not as errors.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.

tools.name: servicenow_check_capabilities
tools.description: Preflight which admin-restricted sys_* tables the connected user can actually read, and report which higher-level capabilities (schema reads, script intelligence, ACL audit) are achievable. Run this before relying on the scripts/flows/codecheck tools on a governed instance — on a least-privilege account those reads may be silently empty.

instance.description: Connection profile to use for this call (default: the active profile). See servicenow_list_instances.
